about: Ground plan for the Picasso area (docs/SMOOTH_PATHS.md, drawn by src/ground-plan.ts, checked by scripts/check_ground_plan.py). World metres: x east, z south. So far the car park's north entrance: its asphalt, the gatehouse island and the narrow planter.
trust: The north entrance is traced from Dave's Google 3D top-down screenshot registered to the aerial (about 1.5 m) and read against Street View from Calle Loira and Calle Bolivia (Oct 2024) and IMG_3131. The apron's road-side edges follow the mapped Loira and Bolivia ribbons.

surfaces.name: Car park north entrance: asphalt round the gatehouse island
surfaces.note: Both lanes either side of the gatehouse island and the strip west of the narrow planter are asphalt in the photos (IMG_3131, Street View) and the Google view, joining Calle Loira and Calle Bolivia to the car park. Traced from Dave's Google 3D top-down screenshot (Imagery © Google 2026) registered to the Esri aerial at 0.0385 m per pixel with the long wall's north end on (-91.4, -67.8), good to about 1.5 m. Its north edge runs just under the road ribbons; its south edge is the car-park outline's north edge, its east edge the long wall's inner face, its west edge the brick strip's east edge. The model drew this as generic terracotta before.

surfaces.name: Gatehouse island: terracotta apron on a white kerb
surfaces.note: The island between the entry and exit lanes: a round lawn bed to the north, the gatehouse in the middle and a terracotta apron to the south and east, where both barrier cabinets stand. White kerbs in Street View from Calle Loira. Traced from Dave's Google 3D top-down screenshot (Imagery © Google 2026) registered to the Esri aerial at 0.0385 m per pixel with the long wall's north end on (-91.4, -67.8), good to about 1.5 m.

edges.note: White kerb round the island (Street View from Calle Loira and Calle Bolivia); its height is a guess.

surfaces.name: Gatehouse island: round lawn bed
surfaces.note: Lawn round the gatehouse's north and west sides under trees and palms; a brick border on a white kerb faces the entry lane (Street View from Calle Loira; Google view). The trees and palms are left for the detail stage. Traced from Dave's Google 3D top-down screenshot (Imagery © Google 2026) registered to the Esri aerial at 0.0385 m per pixel with the long wall's north end on (-91.4, -67.8), good to about 1.5 m.

edges.note: Brick border on the kerb top (Street View from Calle Loira).

surfaces.name: Narrow planter west of the entry lane
surfaces.note: A narrow bed about 5 m long with a brick-edged white kerb and bougainvillea, its south tip just north of the entry barrier's bollard (Street View from Calle Loira, IMG_3131's white kerb nose; Google view). The white pillar with notices at its south end and the planting are left for the detail stage. Traced from Dave's Google 3D top-down screenshot (Imagery © Google 2026) registered to the Esri aerial at 0.0385 m per pixel with the long wall's north end on (-91.4, -67.8), good to about 1.5 m.

edges.note: White kerb with a brick edge (Street View from Calle Loira, IMG_3131).
